blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Egocentric action transfer aims to decouple the semantic action from egocentric observations and reproduce them in new visual contexts, enabling scalable world simulation, embodied policy learning, and robotic data generation. Existing approaches to transferring actions rely on condition-guided video generation, which converts the observation video into explicit geometric controls (e.g., hand poses or meshes) to drive synthesis. However, these methods introduce geometric estimation errors, making it difficult to preserve physically plausible interactions when transferred to new scenes. Alternatively, motion transfer methods directly extract motion patterns from the observation video, yet motion-level features alone cannot encode rich contact dynamics, frequently leading to severe hand structural collapse and implausible contact layout. To address both limitations, we present EgoACT, a test-time framework for egocentric action transfer that operates directly on the denoising process of video diffusion models without requiring additional geometric estimators. EgoACT uses Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring to stabilize reference-consistent hand-object structure in the early denoising stage, and Sparse Correspondence Calibration to refine reliable local correspondences in the mid-to-late denoising stages. Together, these two components preserve transferable action semantics while improving temporal coherence and interaction realism. We further establish EgoActionBench, a benchmark for evaluating action preservation, visual quality, and hand-object plausibility across diverse egocentric manipulation scenarios. Experiments show that EgoACT generates more coherent and physically plausible interaction videos than strong baselines.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Egocentric action transfer aims to decouple the semantic action from egocentric observations and reproduce it in new visual scenes, enabling scalable world simulation, embodied policy learning, and robotic data generation. The core challenge is to decouple what action is being performed from how the current scene happens to look , so that the interaction logic, including contact transitions, object responses, and coordinated hand-object dynamics , can be faithfully reproduced in novel scenarios.
blocks.zh: Egocentration 动作转移旨在将语义动作从自我中心观测中解析出来,并在新的视觉场景中复制,从而能够进行可扩展的世界模拟,体现政策学习和机器人数据生成. 核心挑战在于将当前场景的演绎方式与当前场景的外观脱钩,这样,互动逻辑,包括接触过渡,对象响应,以及协调的手-对象动态,就可以在新情景中忠实地复制.

blocks.en: Existing approaches to transferring egocentric actions are predominantly formulated as condition-guided video generation [ 77 , 88 , 71 ] . These methods first convert an observation video into explicit geometric controls, such as keypoints, hand poses, or mesh sequences [ 11 , 74 , 24 ] , and then force the target video to follow these extracted conditions. However, these methods rely on accurate geometric estimation and inevitably introduce external errors into the generation process. When transferred to a new scene, the injected geometric controls cannot guarantee physically valid interactions (Fig. 2 ). An alternative line of work, motion transfer [ 45 , 43 , 37 ] , sidesteps explicit geometric estimation by extracting and replaying motion patterns directly from the observation video. While this avoids estimator-induced errors, motion-level features alone cannot encode the rich contact dynamics inherent in egocentric manipulation. These methods frequently suffer from severe hand structural collapse and implausible contact layout (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 转让以自我为中心的行动的现有办法主要是作为以条件为指南的视频生成[77、88、71]。 这些方法首先将一个观测视频转换成明显的几何控制,如键位,手姿,或网格序列[11,74,24],然后强迫目标视频遵循这些提取的条件. 然而,这些方法依赖于准确的几何估计,并不可避免地将外部错误引入生成过程. 当转移到新场景时,注入的几何控制不能保证物理上有效的相互作用(图2 ). 另一条工作线,运动转移[45,43,37],通过直接从观察视频中提取和重播运动规律,绕过明显的几何估计. 虽然这可以避免估计引起的错误,但光是运动级别特征无法编码自我中心操纵所固有的丰富的接触动态. 这些方法经常受到严重的手结构崩溃和难以想象的接触布局(图2)的影响.

blocks.en: To address this, instead of hard-copying sparse geometric structures or replaying raw motion from an observation video, we aim to extract the transferable semantic action from an egocentric observation and use it to synthesize a new interaction video under a different visual realization. This setting asks the model to preserve the interaction logic behind the motion, including contact timing, object response, and coherent hand-object coordination, rather than the observation appearance or exact geometric condition.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们不是用硬拷贝稀有的几何结构,或从一个观察视频中重播原始运动,而是要从一个自我中心观察中提取可转移的语义动作,用它来合成一个不同视觉实现下的新互动视频. 这种设定要求模型保留运动背后的相互作用逻辑,包括接触时间,对象反应,以及连贯的手对象协调,而不是观察外观或精确的几何条件.

blocks.zh: 图2:动机。 运动转移受到手结构崩溃的影响,缺乏物理互动. 条件制导的生成保存手形,但产生物理上不可信的接触. 我们的方法既保持手结构,又保持现实的互动。

blocks.en: In this work, we present EgoACT, a test-time action transfer framework for egocentric world simulation. We observe that egocentric action transfer faces two major failure modes during generation. First, hand-object structural collapse often occurs in the early denoising stage, where action guidance can distort hands, objects, and contact geometry before a stable interaction layout is formed. Second, physically unrealistic interaction can still appear even when visible motion is roughly aligned, because local correspondences, contact timing, and object responses may drift in later denoising stages. To address these challenges, EgoACT combines two complementary test-time refinements. Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring (VSA) stabilizes early denoising by preserving reference-consistent hand-object structure, while Sparse Correspondence Calibration (SCC) refines mid-to-late denoising by correcting reliable local correspondences around interaction regions.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了EgoACT, 一个以自我为中心的世界模拟的试验时间动作转移框架。 我们注意到,以自我为中心的动作转移在一代人中面临两种主要的失败模式。 首先,手-对象结构崩溃经常发生在早期的去诺化阶段,其中动作引导可以扭曲手,物体,在形成稳定的相互作用布局之前接触几何. 第二,物理上不切实际的交互即使在可见运动大致对齐时仍然可以出现,因为局部的通信,接触时间,以及物体的反应可能在后来的去诺阶段漂移. 为了应对这些挑战,EgoACT将两个互补的测试时间改进结合起来. 极速导结构安魂曲(VSA)通过保留与参考一致的手形结构来稳定早期去诺,而Sparse函授校正(SCC)则通过校正互动区域周围可靠的本地函授来完善中后期去诺.

blocks.en: Beyond the method, we establish EgoActionBench, a benchmark for evaluating egocentric action transfer. EgoActionBench contains 350 egocentric manipulation videos covering diverse interaction categories, object types, hand configurations, and scene layouts. It evaluates not only visual fidelity, but also action preservation, temporal coherence, and hand-object interaction plausibility. Experiments on EgoActionBench show that EgoACT produces more coherent transferred actions and more plausible hand-object interactions than strong baselines, supporting the effectiveness of our formulation. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We analyze the challenges of egocentric action transfer and propose EgoACT, a test-time action transfer framework that decouples transferable action semantics from observation visual appearance without additional training. • Technically, we introduce Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring and Sparse Correspondence Calibration , which respectively address hand-object structural collapse and physically unrealistic interaction. • We establish EgoActionBench, a benchmark for evaluating egocentric action transfer comprehensively, and conduct extensive experiments that support the effectiveness of our formulation and method.
blocks.zh: 除了这个方法之外,我们建立了EgoAction Bench, 一个评估自我中心行动转移的基准。 EgoAction Bench包含350个以自我为中心的操纵视频,涵盖不同的交互类别,对象类型,手的配置,以及场景布局. 它不仅评价视觉忠贞性,而且评价动作保全,时间一致性,以及手物体交互的可信度. 关于EgoAction Bench的实验表明,EgoACT比强基线产生更连贯的转移动作和更可信的手物交互作用,支持我们的表述效果. • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们分析以自我为中心的动作转移的挑战,并提出EgoACT,即试时动作转移框架,将可转移的动作语义与观察视觉外观脱钩,而无需额外训练. • 支助 从技术上讲,我们引入了高速导引结构安魂曲和Sparse函授校准,分别处理手物体结构崩溃和物理上不切实际的相互作用。 我们建立了EgoAction Bench,作为全面评价自我中心行动转移的基准,并进行广泛的实验,支持我们制定和方法的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video Motion Transfer. Motion transfer aims to synthesize novel videos by preserving reference motion dynamics, requiring effective decoupling of spatial appearance and temporal motion. Early works [ 15 , 77 , 78 , 8 , 88 , 71 , 87 ] rely on explicit control signals, which demand large-scale annotations and substantial computation. Consequently, recent diffusion models shift toward implicit control, employing either parameter-efficient tuning [ 89 , 26 , 52 , 72 ] or inference-time motion extraction [ 23 , 47 , 49 , 48 , 50 , 81 , 14 , 46 , 37 , 75 ] . However, these frameworks primarily target 3D U-Nets [ 3 ] . As models evolve toward Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ 44 ] with fully coupled 3D attention, traditional methods relying on explicit spatio-temporal separation become difficult to apply. Recent DiT-based adaptations explore attention flow optimization [ 45 ] , parameter-efficient tuning [ 1 ] , temporal kernel encoding [ 54 ] , and streamlined extraction [ 43 ] . However, these methods still focus primarily on visible motion transfer, while egocentric action transfer requires preserving contact transitions and hand-object dynamics.
blocks.zh: 视频移动传输. 运动转移旨在通过保存参考运动动态来合成新视频,需要有效解析空间外观和时间运动. 早期作品[15,77,78,8,88,71,87]依靠明确的控制信号,这需要大尺度的说明和大量的计算. 因此,最近的传播模式转向隐含控制,采用参数效率调制[89、26、52、72]或推断时间运动提取[23、47、49、48、50、81、14、46、37、75]。 然而,这些框架主要针对3D U-Nets[3]。 随着模型向传播变形器(DiTs)[44]进化,并完全结合了3D的注意力,依赖明显的时空分离的传统方法变得难以应用. 最近基于DiT的适应探索了注意力流优化[45],参数效率调制[1],时间内核编码[54],以及精简提取[43]. 然而,这些方法仍然主要侧重于可见运动转移,而以自我为中心的动作转移则需要保持接触过渡和手物体动态.

blocks.en:
Interaction-Centric Video Generation. Recent advances in diffusion have increasingly pushed generative video models toward the paradigm of video world modeling [ 4 , 5 , 21 ] , where the goal is to capture not only visual appearance but also the underlying dynamics and interactions of the physical world. Some works [ 30 , 86 , 40 ] address interactive manipulation video generation by introducing structured interaction signals to improve controllability and physical plausibility. Methods such as Mask2IV [ 30 ] and VHOI [ 86 ] leverage mask trajectories or keypoints to guide fine-grained interactions. Other approaches incorporate more explicit control cues or geometric priors, such as InterDyn [ 2 ] , GenHSI [ 33 ] , and ZeroHSI [ 31 ] . EgoSim [ 16 ] and Hand2World [ 70 ] further introduce egocentric conditioning or structured world representations to enhance interaction realism and consistency.
Despite these advances, existing methods largely rely on external condition estimators [ 11 , 74 , 24 ] to guide the generation of physically consistent interaction videos, which limit practical application. In contrast, we propose EgoACT, which enhances interaction consistency without requiring external estimators, enabling more robust interaction world modeling.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given an egocentric manipulation video x ref x^{\mathrm{ref}} that demonstrates a source action, egocentric action transfer aims to synthesize a new video x gen x^{\mathrm{gen}} that preserves the transferable action semantics while allowing the visual realization to change. The transferred signal should not be limited to visible hand displacement, but should also retain the underlying interaction logic, including contact transitions, object response, and coordinated hand-object dynamics. In this section, we first discuss the motivation and key challenges of egocentric action transfer in Sec. 3.1 . We then introduce Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring (VSA) in Sec. 3.2 , which stabilizes the global hand-object structure during the early denoising stage. Finally, we present Sparse Correspondence Calibration (SCC) in Sec. 3.3 , which refines local temporal correspondences in the mid-to-late denoising stages.

blocks.en: 3.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 动机

blocks.en: Egocentric action transfer requires the model to transfer the semantic action from a reference egocentric observation while synthesizing a new interaction video under a different visual realization. Consistent with the discussion in Sec. 1 , this setting is difficult because the model must preserve the interaction logic behind the motion rather than simply reproduce visible hand displacement. We focus on two failure modes that commonly appear during generation:
blocks.zh: Egocentre动作传输需要模型从参考自我中心观察中转移语义动作,同时在不同的视觉实现下合成一个新的交互视频. 与第1节的讨论一致,这种设置很困难,因为模型必须保持运动背后的相互作用逻辑,而不是简单地复制可见的手移位. 我们侧重于两种在一代人时期常见的失败模式:

blocks.en: Hand-object Structural Collapse. Explicit condition guidance usually converts the reference video into geometric controls, such as keypoints, hand poses, or mesh sequences, and then forces the generation process to follow these controls. Although this can preserve coarse motion, it is fragile in egocentric manipulation, where hands are frequently occluded, distorted by perspective, and tightly coupled with objects. Noisy or distribution-mismatched controls can over-constrain the early denoising trajectory, leading to broken fingers, distorted hands, collapsed objects, or implausible contact geometry.
blocks.zh: 手-对象结构折叠. 明确条件指导通常将参考视频转换成几何控制,如键位,手姿,或网格序列,然后迫使生成过程遵循这些控制. 虽然这可以保持粗糙的动作,但是在以自我为中心的操纵中却很脆弱,手经常被缠绕,被视角扭曲,并且与物体紧密结合. 噪音或分布相匹配的控制可以过度限制早期的去诺化轨迹,导致手指断裂,手部扭曲,物体崩溃,或难以想象的接触几何.

blocks.en: Physically Unrealistic Interaction. Even when visible motion is roughly aligned, the generated video may still fail to preserve the physical logic of manipulation, such as when contact is established, how the object responds, and whether local hand-object correspondences remain temporally consistent. This problem becomes especially apparent in the mid-to-late denoising stages, where fine-grained appearance and contact details are formed.
blocks.zh: 身体不现实的相互作用。 即使在可见运动大致对齐时,生成的视频仍然可能无法维护操纵的物理逻辑,如接触何时建立,物体如何反应,以及局部的手目标通信是否在时间上保持一致. 这个问题在中晚期解密阶段变得特别明显,在那里形成了精细的外表和联系细节.

blocks.en: To address these two failure modes, EgoACT performs two complementary latent optimization steps during inference. Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring (VSA) is applied in the early denoising stage to keep the generation close to reference-consistent hand-object structure, reducing structural collapse before the interaction layout is formed. Sparse Correspondence Calibration (SCC) is then applied in the mid-to-late denoising stages to correct reliable local correspondences around interaction regions, improving temporal consistency and hand-object realism without additional training.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这两个故障模式,EgoACT在推论中进行了两个互补的潜在优化步骤. 极速导结构安魂曲(VSA)在早期的去诺化阶段应用,使生成者保持接近参照-一致的手对象结构,在形成相互作用布局前减少结构崩溃. 然后,Sparse函授校准(SCC)在中后期解析阶段应用,以校正围绕互动区域的可靠的本地函证,提高时间一致性和手目标现实主义,而无需额外训练.

3.2 Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring
blocks.zh: 3.2 高速制导结构

blocks.en: To prevent the hand-object structural layout from being severely derailed during the initial motion injection, we propose V elocity-guided S tructure A nchoring (VSA) at the early guidance steps. In egocentric manipulation, the source observation does not merely provide a motion template; it also encodes implicit physical knowledge about feasible hand-object contacts, relative object motion, and interaction timing. Directly injecting motion cues without preserving this knowledge can produce trajectories that follow the reference displacement but violate the physical structure of the manipulation process. VSA therefore uses the reference branch as a structure-and-physics anchor at the same noise level, aligning the generation trajectory with both the kinematic layout and the interaction dynamics implied by the observation video.

blocks.en: 3.3 Sparse Correspondence Calibration
blocks.zh: 3.3 平面通信校准

blocks.en: While VSA stabilizes the macroscopic structure in the early stage of denoising, cross-frame correspondences may still drift during the following denoising process. Existing global optimization strategies, such as test-time optimization [ 28 , 32 , 73 ] , usually regularize the noisy latent with dense reconstruction, feature, or motion-level objectives. In egocentric manipulation, however, the visual content and action semantics are tightly coupled: hands, objects, and contact states jointly determine whether a trajectory remains valid. Global objectives tend to dilute these fine-grained vision-action constraints into a single optimization target, which may over-correct the latent and unintentionally alter object appearance, hand-object relations, or the intended action.
blocks.zh: 虽然VSA在解密初期稳定了宏观结构,但跨框架函证在接下来的解密过程中仍然可能漂移. 现有的全球优化策略,如测试时间优化[28,32,73],通常将噪音潜伏的密集重建,特征,或运动级目标规范化. 然而在以自我为中心的操纵中,视觉内容和行动语义是紧密结合的:手,物体,和接触状态共同决定一个轨迹是否仍然有效. 全球目标往往将这些细微的视觉行动限制淡化成单一的优化目标,这可能会过度纠正潜在和无意改变物体外观、手物关系或预期行动。

blocks.en: To address this, we introduce S parse C orrespondence C alibration (SCC), which operates within a valid diffusion path and aligns the local correspondence distributions between the reference and generated branches at equivalent noise levels. By optimizing only the reliable sparse matching support induced by the reference branch, SCC provides a more targeted correction signal for local interaction-level correspondence drift while avoiding unnecessary updates on ambiguous or irrelevant regions.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了S parse C 或resignence C alibration(SCC),它在一个有效的扩散路径中运作,并在相当噪声级别上协调参考和生成分支之间的本地通信分布. SCC通过优化仅由参考分支引申的可靠稀疏匹配支持,为本地交互级的函文漂移提供了更有针对性的校正信号,同时避免了对模糊或不相关的区域不必要的更新.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: In our experiments, we implement EgoACT on top of a pre-trained video diffusion transformer [ 65 ] and keep all model parameters frozen during inference. Unless otherwise specified, videos are sampled with 50 denoising steps at a resolution of 832 × \times 480 and 81 frames. During inference, we apply the sliding-window AMF guidance in the first 20% of the outer denoising process to stabilize the hand-object layout, and use SCC in the mid-to-late denoising stage from step 35 to 45 to calibrate local correspondences. Each guided outer step performs a 10-step latent-only optimization with AdamW, where the learning rate is linearly decayed from 0.003 to 0.002. More implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们执行EgoACT在预先训练的视频传播变压器之上[65],并在推论中保持所有模型参数的冻结. 除非另有说明,视频在分辨率为832 ×\时间 480和81帧时进行50个调号步骤的取样。 在推论中,我们应用了在前20%的外消音过程中的滑窗AMF引导来稳定手物体布局,并在从第35步到第45步的中到晚的解音阶段使用SCC来校准本地的通信. 每个带导外步都与亚当W进行10步仅潜伏优化,学习率从0.003线性衰变到0.002线性衰变. 补充材料中提供了更多的执行细节。

blocks.en:
EgoActionBench. We establish EgoActionBench to evaluate egocentric action transfer in action-centric world simulation.
EgoActionBench is built from online egocentric manipulation videos, public manipulation datasets [ 13 , 20 , 12 ] , and generated videos from powerful video diffusion models [ 65 , 18 , 29 ] . It contains 350 high-quality observation videos and 1,400 evaluation prompts, covering 287 indoor and 63 outdoor scenes, with 164 single-hand and 186 two-hand interactions. The actions include grasping, opening, pouring, placing, tool use, and handover across diverse objects and interaction patterns. To ensure the visual quality of benchmark, we filter out clips with excessive ego-camera motion, severe blur, heavy occlusion, objects leaving the frame, unclear hand-object contact, incomplete actions, or corrupted frames. For each retained video, GPT-5 generates an action-centric source caption, from which we derive 4 target prompts by changing the scene, object appearance, or background while preserving the original action semantics. All prompts are manually checked to avoid reference-specific appearance leakage. Each sample is annotated with scene type, hand type, action category, and object category.
blocks.zh:
Ego Action Bench (英语). 我们建立了EgoAction Bench 来评价以自我为中心的动作在以行动为中心的世界模拟中的转移.
EgoAction Bench由网络自负式操纵视频,公共操纵数据集[13,20,12]所建,由强大的视频传播模型生成的视频[65,18,29]. 它包含350个高质量的观测视频和1400个评价提示,涵盖287个室内场景和63个室外场景,有164个单手和186个双手互动. 这些行动包括把握、打开、倾注、放置、工具使用以及跨越不同对象和互动模式的移交。 为了保证基准的视觉质量,我们用过度的自我-相机运动,严重的模糊,沉重的隐蔽,离开帧的物体,不明的手物体接触,不完整的行动,或者腐烂的帧来过滤剪辑. 对于每个保留下来的视频,GPT-5生成一个以动作为中心的源标题,我们从中通过改变场景,对象外观,或背景来获得4个目标提示,同时保留原动作语义. 所有提示都经过人工检查,以避免特定参考的外观渗漏. 每个样本都附有场景类型,手型,动作类,以及对象类的注释.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 与基线的比较

blocks.en: Qualitative comparison. We compare EgoACT with representative egocentric manipulation and interaction generation methods, including VACE [ 27 ] , Mask2IV [ 30 ] , CosHand [ 61 ] , InterDyn [ 2 ] , and DiTFlow [ 45 ] . As shown in Fig. 8 , previous methods exhibit different failure patterns in egocentric manipulation transfer. Mask2IV and CosHand better preserve hand shape but struggle with contact consistency, often generating implausible object responses such as objects remaining static despite clear grasping motion. InterDyn and DiTFlow introduce visible structural artifacts when hands and objects are tightly coupled, leading to floating contacts or broken spatial relations. In contrast, EgoACT preserves a more stable hand-object layout while maintaining temporally coherent contact and physically plausible object response throughout the interaction sequence. These qualitative results confirm that VSA suppresses early structural collapse by anchoring the hand-object skeleton, while SCC improves local correspondence consistency in the later denoising stages to produce more realistic contact dynamics.

blocks.en: Quantitative comparison. We quantitatively compare EgoACT with VACE [ 27 ] , Mask2IV [ 30 ] , CosHand [ 61 ] , InterDyn [ 2 ] , and DiTFlow [ 45 ] on EgoActionBench. blocks.en: Effectiveness of VSA. As shown in Table 2 and Fig. 9 , removing VSA leads to notable degradation in hand generation quality. Without velocity-guided anchoring in early denoising, the generation trajectory lacks structural constraints from the reference branch, causing frequent hand distortion, broken fingers, and implausible contact geometry. With VSA enabled, the reference velocity field steers the latent toward a structurally consistent manifold, preventing structural collapse before the interaction skeleton is established.
blocks.zh: 自愿服务协定的效力。 如表2和图9所示,取消VSA会导致手工生产质量明显退化。 没有速度导锚在早期的去诺化,生成轨迹缺乏来自参考分支的结构约束,导致手经常扭曲,手指断裂,接触几何不可信. 随着VSA的启用,参考速度场引导潜伏物向结构一致的多面体方向发展,在相互作用骨架建立之前防止结构崩溃.

blocks.en: Effectiveness of SCC. Disabling SCC preserves coarse hand motion but degrades fine-grained interaction quality. Without correspondence calibration, local hand-object correspondences drift across frames, resulting in contact jitter and delayed object response (Table 2 , Fig. 9 ). We apply SCC in the mid-to-late denoising stages (steps 35–45): early-stage correction over-constrains the latent and disrupts action-appearance decoupling, while late-stage intervention has limited effect as fine details have solidified. This window allows SCC to refine correspondences after the global layout is stabilized by VSA, yielding more plausible interactions.
blocks.zh: SCC的有效性. 失效的SCC保留了粗糙的手动,但降解了细纹的相互作用质量. 不进行函证校准,本地的手物函证会漂移到不同帧之间,导致接触紧张和延迟对象响应(表2,图9). 在中后期的解密阶段(第35至45步),我们应用SCC:早期的纠正过度限制潜在的和扰乱了行动出现的脱钩,而后期的干预作用有限,因为细节已经巩固。 这个窗口允许SCC在全局布局由VSA稳定后完善对应,从而产生更可信的相互作用.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present EgoACT, a test-time action transfer framework for egocentric world simulation that decouples transferable action semantics from source visual appearance without additional training. EgoACT addresses two critical failure modes in egocentric manipulation transfer: hand-object structural collapse in early denoising and physically unrealistic interaction in later stages. Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring (VSA) stabilizes the global hand-object layout by aligning the generation trajectory with reference-consistent velocity fields during early denoising, while Sparse Correspondence Calibration (SCC) refines local correspondences around interaction regions in the mid-to-late stages to improve contact consistency and object response plausibility. We also introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark with 350 egocentric manipulation videos and 1,400 evaluation prompts spanning diverse scenes, hand configurations, and interaction categories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoACT outperforms existing methods in both quantitative metrics and human evaluation, producing more coherent action transfer with plausible hand-object interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了EgoACT,一个测试时间动作转移框架,用于自我中心世界模拟,这种模拟将可转移的动作语义与源视觉外观脱钩,而无需额外的训练. EgoACT在自我中心操纵转移中解决两种关键故障模式:早期去诺化时的手目标结构崩溃和后期的物理上不切实际的互动. 极速导结构安魂曲(VSA)通过在早期解空时使生成轨迹与参照一致的速度场对齐,稳定了全局的手物体布局,而Sparse函授校正(SCC)则在中后期阶段完善了交互区域周围的局部函授,以提高接触一致性和对象响应的可信度. 我们亦推出EgoAction Bench, 以350个自我中心操控视频为基准, 广泛的实验表明,EgoACT在定量计量和人类评价方面都超越了现有方法,产生了更连贯的行动转移,具有可信的手物体相互作用。

blocks.en: Test-Time Visual Generation. Video generation [ 41 , 59 , 42 , 66 , 69 , 39 , 67 ] has advanced rapidly, largely driven by recent progress in diffusion models. Test-time methods enhance pre-trained models during inference without retraining [ 35 , 62 , 68 ] . Existing approaches primarily follow two paradigms. First, test-time scaling improves quality through iterative candidate search [ 38 , 17 ] , preference optimization [ 64 , 63 ] , or VLM-guided reflection [ 76 , 90 ] . However, this process requires prohibitive computational costs and shows marginal improvements for continuous diffusion models due to inherent architectural constraints [ 51 , 57 ] . Second, test-time optimization refines outputs via auxiliary parameter updates [ 53 , 36 , 56 , 83 , 84 , 85 , 6 , 22 , 79 , 60 , 10 , 58 , 80 , 9 , 7 , 82 , 19 ] , prompt tuning [ 55 ] , or layout-guided latent optimization [ 28 , 32 , 34 , 73 ] , but often relies on complex instance-specific training or global objectives. In contrast, our test-time refinements target the hand-object structure and local correspondences needed for egocentric action transfer.
blocks.zh: 试时视觉一代. 视频生成[41,59,42,66,69,39,67]进展迅速,主要受传播模式近期进展的推动. 试验时间方法在不进行再培训的情况下加强预先训练的模型[35、62、68]。 现有办法主要遵循两种模式。 首先,测试时间的缩放通过迭代候选人搜索[38,17],偏好优化[64,63],或VLM引导反射[76,90],提高质量. 然而,由于固有的建筑限制,这一过程需要高昂的计算成本,并显示出对持续传播模型的微小改进[51,57]. 第二,测试时间优化通过辅助参数更新[53,36,56,83,84,85,6,22,79,60,10,58,80,9,7,82,19],即时调制[55],或布局引导潜伏优化[28,32,34,73],但往往依赖于复杂的实例培训或全球目标. 相比之下,我们测试时间的改进针对的是以自我为中心的动作转移所需的手目标结构和本地通信。

blocks.en: Attention Motion Flow (AMF) [ 43 ] extracts implicit motion cues from the self-attention layers of a video diffusion transformer. The key observation is that cross-frame query-key affinity in DiT attention naturally encodes patch-level correspondences: if a token in one frame attends strongly to a token in a neighboring frame, their spatial offset provides an estimate of the local motion. Instead of using external trackers or optical-flow estimators, we compute AMF directly from the internal attention features of the frozen generation model. To instantiate this intuition, we compute token-level correspondences from local query-key affinities within self-attention.
blocks.zh: 注意运动流(AMF)[43]从视频扩散变压器的自留心层中提取隐含运动提示. 关键观察是,DiT中的跨帧查询键亲和性自然地编码了补丁级对应:如果一个帧中的某个符符强烈地关注邻边框中的某个符符,它们的空间偏移提供了局部运动的估计. 我们不使用外部跟踪器或光流估计器,而是直接从冷冻生成模型的内部注意特征计算出AMF. 为了即兴发挥这种直觉,我们从本地查询键的亲和度中计算出符号级的函证。

The lower bound m min m_{\min} ensures that low-motion regions still contribute weakly to the velocity anchoring objective, which helps preserve global scene layout and prevents the optimization from overfitting only to highly dynamic tokens.

blocks.en: Therefore, the AMF-induced mask allocates optimization strength adaptively: dynamic interaction regions are emphasized, whereas static regions are softly regularized. This design allows VSA in Sec. 3.2 to focus on the action-critical structure without imposing unnecessarily strong constraints on unrelated background content.

blocks.en: Appendix D More Details about User Study
blocks.zh: 附录D 关于用户研究的更多细节

blocks.en: To complement automatic metrics, we conduct a user study with 20 volunteers on 50 randomly selected cases from EgoActionBench. For each evaluated case, volunteers are shown the reference egocentric manipulation video, the target text prompt, and generated videos from all compared methods. The method names are hidden, and the generated videos are presented in randomized order to reduce ordering bias.
blocks.zh: 为了补充自动衡量标准,我们与20名志愿者一起对来自EgoAction Bench的50个随机选择的病例进行用户研究。 对于每个被评价的个案,志愿者都会看到以参考自我为中心的操纵视频,目标文本提示,以及所有比较方法产生的视频. 方法名称被隐藏,生成的视频按照随机化的顺序呈现,以减少排序偏差.

blocks.en: Annotators evaluate each generated result according to the following four criteria: ∙ \bullet Appearance Consistency: whether the generated video preserves a coherent target appearance across frames without obvious identity drift, texture inconsistency, or visual artifacts. ∙ \bullet Text Alignment: whether the generated video follows the target prompt, including the described scene, object appearance, and intended manipulation context. ∙ \bullet Temporal Consistency: whether the generated video remains stable over time without obvious flickering, jittering, ghosting, or frame-to-frame structural instability. ∙ \bullet Motion Fidelity: whether the generated video preserves the reference action pattern, including hand motion, contact timing, and object response, without severe drifting or motion collapse.
blocks.zh: 注释员根据下列四个标准评价每个结果: 一致性:生成的视频是否保留了清晰的跨帧目标外观,没有明显的身份漂移,纹理不一致,或者视觉文物. *\bullet 文本对齐:生成的视频是否跟随目标提示,包括描述的场景,对象外观,以及意图的操纵上下文. * 暂时性 一致性:生成的视频在一段时间内是否保持稳定,没有明显的闪烁,抖动,幽灵,或者帧对帧的结构不稳定. *\Bullet Motion Fidelity:生成的视频是否保留了参考动作模式,包括手动,接触时间,以及物体响应,没有严重的漂移或运动崩溃.

blocks.en: Appearance Consistency: whether the generated video preserves a coherent target appearance across frames without obvious identity drift, texture inconsistency, or visual artifacts.
blocks.zh: 外观一致性:生成的视频是否保留了清晰的目标跨帧外观,没有明显的身份漂移,纹理不一致,或者视觉文物.

blocks.en: Each dimension is rated using a four-level ordinal scale: Excellent (fully satisfies the criterion with no obvious artifacts), Good (minor artifacts or deviations), Pass (noticeable but acceptable issues), and Fail (severe artifacts or failure to satisfy the criterion). The final statistics are obtained by aggregating ratings across all volunteers and evaluated cases.

blocks.en: Appendix E More Details about EgoActionBench
blocks.zh: 附录E 更多关于EgoAction Bench的细节

blocks.en:
EgoActionBench focuses on whether the generated video preserves the interaction logic of the reference action, including contact transitions, object response, and coordinated hand-object dynamics.
The main paper summarizes the data sources, category coverage, and basic filtering rules of EgoActionBench. The benchmark contains 350 reference videos, with 4 target prompts for each video, resulting in 1,400 evaluation prompts. It includes 287 indoor scenes and 63 outdoor scenes, with 164 single-hand and 186 two-hand manipulation cases. In terms of data composition, approximately 60% of the reference videos are sourced from real-world egocentric recordings (online videos and public manipulation datasets), while the remaining 40% are generated by video diffusion models to cover rarer manipulation categories and ensure diversity. Here we provide additional details about camera-motion filtering, prompt construction, and manual quality control.
blocks.zh:
EgoAction Bench专注于生成的视频是否保留了参考动作的交互逻辑,包括接触过渡,对象响应,以及协调的手-对象动态.
主要论文总结了EgoAction Bench的数据来源,类别覆盖面,以及基本过滤规则. 基准包含350个参考视频,每个视频有4个目标提示,结果有1400个评价提示. 它包括287个室内场景和63个室外场景,其中164个单手和186个双手操纵案件. 在数据构成方面,大约60%的参考视频来源于现实世界的自我中心录音(在线视频和公共操纵数据集),其余的40%通过视频传播模型生成,以涵盖稀有的操纵类别并确保多样性. 在这里,我们提供了更多关于相机运动过滤、快速构造和人工质量控制的细节。

blocks.en: Egocentric videos often contain strong head or body motion, which can make action transfer evaluation ambiguous: a method may appear to fail because the reference observation is dominated by camera shake rather than hand-object interaction. To reduce this issue, we estimate camera poses with ViPE [ 25 ] for candidate real videos and compute frame-to-frame camera translation and rotation changes. Clips with large pose jumps, unstable pose estimates, or camera motion that dominates the hand-object region are removed before manual inspection. This filtering step keeps moderate egocentric viewpoint changes while excluding references where the manipulated object cannot be reliably tracked in the image plane.
blocks.zh: 爱果中心视频经常包含强头或身体运动,这可能会使动作转移评价变得模糊不清:一种方法可能看起来失败,因为参考观测以相机抖动而不是手-对象交互为主. 为了减少这个问题,我们估计摄像机与VIPE [25] 相机用于候选真实视频,并计算帧到帧相机的翻译和旋转变化. 具有较大姿势跳跃,不稳定姿势估计的剪贴,或者在人工检查前移除主导手物体区域的相机运动. 这一过滤步骤保持了温和的自我中心观点的变化,同时排除了被操纵对象无法在图像平面中可靠跟踪的引用.

blocks.en: For each retained clip, we ask GPT-5 to produce an action-centric caption using the following instruction: Describe the egocentric manipulation action in one sentence. Focus on the actor’s hand motion, the manipulated object, the contact transition, and the object’s response. Do not describe camera motion, video quality, identity, or irrelevant background details. Based on this source caption, we further ask GPT-5 to generate target prompts with the instruction: Rewrite the scene, object appearance, or background while preserving the same manipulation verb, contact order, and object response. Avoid copying reference-specific colors, textures, or scene details unless they are essential to the action. This prompt design encourages evaluation cases that test action transfer rather than source appearance copying.
blocks.zh: 对于每个保留片段,我们请GPT-5使用以下指示制作一个以动作为中心的字幕: 在一句话中描述以自我为中心的操纵行为。 专注于演员的手动,操纵对象,接触过渡,以及对象的反应. 不要描述相机运动,视频质量,身份,或无关的背景细节. 基于这个源标题,我们进一步要求GPT-5用指令生成目标提示: 重写场景,对象外观,或背景,同时保留相同的操纵动词,联系顺序,以及对象响应. 避免复制特定参考颜色、纹理或场景细节,除非它们对动作至关重要。 这种即时设计鼓励测试动作转移而不是源外观复制的评价案例.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : More details about EgoActionBench. EgoActionBench covers diverse egocentric manipulation scenarios and is annotated by scene type, and object category.
blocks.zh: 图13:关于EgoAction Bench的更多详情。 EgoAction Bench涵盖各种以自我为中心的操纵情景,并按场景类型和对象类别附加说明.

blocks.en: After automatic captioning and prompt rewriting, we manually review each benchmark sample. We reject prompts that change the action semantics, introduce physically incompatible objects, leak reference-specific appearance details, or describe interactions that are not visible in the source clip. We also check whether the target prompt is feasible for the reference action; for example, actions involving pouring, opening, or handover require objects with compatible affordances. The remaining samples are annotated with difficulty tags according to contact complexity, object motion magnitude, and whether the action involves one or two hands. These tags are used only for analysis and are not provided to the generation methods.
blocks.zh: 在自动字幕和快速重写后,我们手动审查每个基准样本。 我们拒绝改变动作语义,引入物理不兼容对象,漏出特定参考的外观细节,或者描述源片段中不可见的相互作用的提示. 我们还检查目标速率对于参考行动是否可行;例如,涉及倾注、打开或移交的行动需要具有兼容性的价格的物体。 其余样本根据接触的复杂度,物体运动量,以及动作是否涉及一手或两手,附加困难标记. 这些标记仅用于分析,不提供给生成方法.

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: Although EgoACT achieves strong results on a wide range of egocentric manipulation scenarios, it still struggles with actions involving very fast hand or object motion. As shown in Fig. 14 , the generated videos may exhibit motion blur, temporal aliasing, or loss of hand-object correspondence in such cases. We attribute this limitation primarily to the base video diffusion model, which was not specifically trained to handle rapid egocentric dynamics and tends to produce temporally smoothed outputs when the inter-frame displacement is large. As video foundation models continue to advance in temporal resolution and motion modeling capacity, we expect this limitation to be naturally alleviated. In future work, we also plan to extend EgoACT to longer-horizon action sequences and multi-step task compositions, enabling more complex manipulation planning within the world simulation paradigm.
blocks.zh: 虽然EgoACT在各种以自我为中心的操纵情景上都取得了强劲的结果,但它仍然与涉及非常快速的手动或物体运动的行动发生斗争. 如图14所示,在此种情况下,生成的视频可能显示运动模糊、时间性别名,或丢失手信。 我们把这一限制主要归因于基本的视频传播模型,该模型没有经过专门培训,能够处理快速的自我中心动态,而且往往在机体间迁移较大时产生暂时平滑的产出。 随着视频基础模型在时间分辨率和运动建模能力方面继续取得进展,我们期望这一限制会自然地得到缓解. 在未来的工作中,我们还计划将EgoACT扩展至更长范围的行动序列和多步骤的任务组成,从而能够在世界模拟范式内进行更复杂的操纵规划.

blocks.en: Appendix H Potential Social Impact
blocks.zh: 附录H 潜在的社会影响

blocks.en: Our work studies egocentric action transfer for controllable video world simulation. The potential positive impacts include more efficient simulation for embodied AI, robotics, and human-object interaction research, where generating diverse interaction videos can reduce the cost of collecting physical demonstrations and enable safer testing before real-world deployment. The method may also support content creation and instructional video synthesis when used with appropriate consent and attribution. At the same time, the ability to generate realistic egocentric manipulation videos may be misused to create misleading visual content or to synthesize actions that did not actually occur. Since our method builds on pre-trained video generation models, it may also inherit biases, failure modes, or unsafe generation behaviors from the underlying model and source data. To mitigate these risks, released examples and benchmark assets should be filtered for sensitive or harmful content, and generated videos should be clearly identified as synthetic when used outside research settings. We also recommend applying existing provenance, watermarking, or content moderation tools when deploying such systems in user-facing applications.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作研究自我中心动作转移 用于可控视频世界模拟 潜在的积极影响包括更高效地模拟包含的AI,机器人,以及人与物体的相互作用研究,在这些研究中,生成多样化的相互作用视频可以降低收集物理演示的成本,并能在实际世界部署前进行更安全的测试. 该方法在使用时经适当的同意和归属,也可支持内容创建和教学视频合成. 与此同时,产生现实的自我中心操纵视频的能力可能被滥用,以产生误导的视觉内容或合成实际没有发生的行动. 由于我们的方法建立在预先训练的视频生成模型之上,它也可能继承了基础模型和源数据中的偏差,失败模式,或不安全的生成行为. 为减轻这些风险,应过滤已公布的示例和基准资产,以了解敏感或有害的内容,在使用外部研究环境时,应将制作的录像明确确定为合成的录像。 我们还建议在用户软件应用中应用现有来源、水标记或内容节制工具。
